Other Notes:
The Cracks Are Forming's eyes are pure black in Edit Mode, but should be fine in-match.
The boot models that include the golden boots are using stock PES files that are TGAs compressed to FTEX. Blender can't process these, so you'll have to toggle off Load Textures if you need to import them.
